name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.landing.read.SpeechVoiceReadPaperGuideFailureActivity
description: When a reading check fails and a recovery guide is available, the Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK shows a video or rotating illustrations with instructions and confirm or close controls.
disableEffect: Blocking it removes the retry guidance; users whose reading check fails cannot recover this ad task or receive its reading reward.
